author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Piles of every size are strewn about the room, and nobody told Karel how big they are. Leave the floor bare and go back to where you started.
brief.es: Hay pilas de todos los tamaños repartidas por la sala y nadie le ha dicho a Karel cuántos zumbadores tiene cada una. Deja el suelo limpio y vuelve a la esquina de la que saliste.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION turnright AS
    BEGIN
        turnleft;
        turnleft;
        turnleft
    END
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION clean-corner AS
    BEGIN
        WHILE next-to-a-beeper DO
            pickbeeper
    END
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION clean-row AS
    BEGIN
        clean-corner;
        WHILE front-is-clear DO
        BEGIN
            move;
            clean-corner
        END
    END
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION next-row AS
    BEGIN
        IF facing-east THEN
        BEGIN
            turnleft;
            move;
            turnleft
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            turnright;
            move;
            turnright
        END
    END
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION go-home AS
    BEGIN
        turnleft;
        turnleft;
        WHILE front-is-clear DO
            move;
        turnleft;
        WHILE front-is-clear DO
            move
    END
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        clean-row;
        ITERATE 4 TIMES
        BEGIN
            next-row;
            clean-row
        END
        go-home;
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
